thread:
Maya P: FYI noticing mismatch between ledger and partner reports for NimbleEdge. our entitlement totals dropped to 0 for some devices after the daily TTL prune.

Diego: which shard?

Maya P: shard 12 (asia-west). ledger shows last_heartbeat at 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z, partner says last seen 2025-06-01T00:04:12Z. prune job ran at 00:02Z.

ledger-bot: prune-job triggered on shard 12 at 2025-06-01T00:02:00Z, removed 1,142 stale entitlements.

Jenna (partner-eng): confirmed - NimbleEdge collector had a clock drift on their gateway batch host. it sent batched usage with timestamps 4m ahead; we can produce a replay trimmed to the affected window.

Diego: do we treat their late events as corrections or new usage? our current rule is: if event timestamp > last_heartbeat we treat as "recovery" and reapply, but prune already cleared entitlements so we need reconciliation.

Maya P: need samples. Jenna can you paste two sample events?

Jenna (partner-eng): sample below (redacted):
```json
{"event_id":"ne-20250601-1001","device_id":"dev-778","sku":"NIMBLE-SUB-1","units":10,"event_ts":"2025-06-01T00:04:12Z","received_at":"2025-06-01T00:04:15Z"}
{"event_id":"ne-20250601-1010","device_id":"dev-900","sku":"NIMBLE-SUB-1","units":5,"event_ts":"2025-06-01T00:03:58Z","received_at":"2025-06-01T00:04:05Z"}
```

ops-oncall: two options: 1) replay + delta apply (preferred) 2) manual ledger restore from snapshot before prune. replay path requires idempotency and seqno to avoid duplicates.

Diego: replay path fine. we need partner to include header Idempotency-Id and a seq_no in payload to ensure ordering. also require a replay_manifest listing affected device_ids.

Jenna (partner-eng): will produce replay file now with idempotency_id=nimble_replay_20250601_1 and seq_no fields. they will also backfill timestamps to exactly when events occurred (no future timestamps).

ledger-bot: replay endpoint accepted 2/2 events for replay batch nimble_replay_20250601_1. reconciliation batch created: rec_nimble_20250601_1.

Maya P: we'll run entitlement recalculation against rec_nimble_20250601_1 on shard 12. Diego, can you gate the daily billing cut until we finish?

Diego: gating billing cut for shard 12. estimated recompute 35m.

Jenna (partner-eng): partner will rotate gateway clocks and enable NTP checks across fleet. also adding seqno so retries are idempotent.

Maya P: follow-ups: (a) update partner integration doc with required fields: event_id, seq_no, idempotency header, and heartbeat sync policy; (b) add runbook step: prune job should not run if incoming replay window overlaps last 5 minutes for shard; (c) partner to provide signed acceptance for replay. I'll draft postmortem.

ops-oncall: recompute started at 2025-06-01T00:20:00Z. logging to /runs/1751239876-recompute.log

Maya P: thanks team. will loop in CS if any customer-visible credits needed. :white_check_mark:
